_comment: Two separate sections because the two platforms identify users differently. WhatsApp: map each pilot student's WhatsApp number (with country code, digits only, e.g. 2348012345678) to their school. Telegram: map each pilot student's numeric chat ID to their school — a student gets their chat ID by messaging the bot once; check your Sheet log after their first message to find it, then add them here. Anyone not listed still works fine, just logged under 'Unregistered' until you add them.
